
REMOVE-TAG-FROM-FEATURE
Remove one or more tags from a feature file

USAGE
  fspec remove-tag-from-feature <file> <tags...>

ARGUMENTS
  <file> (required)
    Feature file path
  <tags...> (required)
    One or more tags to remove

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Remove tag
  $ fspec remove-tag-from-feature spec/features/login.feature @wip
  ✓ Removed tag @wip from spec/features/login.feature

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-tag-to-feature
  fspec list-feature-tags
